# Founding Concept v0.1

One Gateway, Many Trusted Services.
Turning collective knowledge into real-world action.

## PURPOSE

The ISAC One Gateway Project is an international civic-tech initiative to build a shared life navigation infrastructure: a companion system that helps people move from "I don't know what to do" to one achievable next step.

Digital services, public information, civic-tech tools, and support organizations are multiplying. 
Yet more services also mean more entry points. 
People can still become lost between websites, applications, offices, professionals, and communities. 
We are not creating one more service. 
We are creating one understandable gateway to many trusted services.

## FOUNDING PRINCIPLES

1.  No dead ends.
    Mimi may not solve every problem, but it should never end with "you are on your own." 
    It should help identify the next safe path.
2.  Connect, don't replace.
    AI should help people reach trusted public services, civic-tech tools, communities, professionals, and supporters--not make every decision on their behalf.
3.  Open participation, trusted review.
    Contribution should be broad.
    Knowledge, prompts, and components distributed as trusted ISAC One Gateway resources should pass appropriate review.
4.  Shared core, local stewardship.
    The method can travel across borders; language, institutions, trusted sources, AI models, and data governance remain locally governed.
5.  Action is the outcome.
    Success is not a long conversation.
    It is a completed task, a clearer next step, a safe handoff, greater capability, or a trusted human connection.
